l.i: dogmata Theologiæ sint divina; sequitur, principia, ex
quibus illa extruuntur, tantum divina esse posse.
Hæc sunt requisita principiorum Theologicorum.

ta competunt. Sic hâc de re habendum. Quælibet
scientia gaudet propriis principiis, supra quæ non licet
ascendere. Infinitorum enim non est scientia. Si ergo
Theologum jubeas sua principia probare, qui tan-
dem id præstabit, nisi per aliud superius? Ast id non
datur. Sed & hic est discrimen principiorum: alia

page.notes: Italic and roman type alternate on this page; the division shown is approximate, particularly around "Sadeel in praefat.operum Theolog." and "Sic Mathematicus". "ogganniat", "usq;dum" and "πληροφορίας" are doubtful readings and are marked [?]. Greek accents and breathings are as far as I can read them at this scan resolution. The page carries printer's marks (asterisks, a dot) at the foot, which are not transcribed.
